scenes.title: Sela's offer at pier four
scenes.summary: Sela Thorn agrees to row the party for two silver, but refuses night trips and offers to meet at first light tomorrow. She says Saltmere Mine flooded forty years ago on the night the bell first rang, and passes on her grandmother's account of warm water.

scenes.title: Hymn pages in Saltmere Mine
scenes.summary: The party finds warm black floodwater and hymn-book pages, including one marked "M. Brand" that Teo identifies as Mira's handwriting. Vessa and Oren suspect Maren's involvement without confirmation; the search yields nothing else, and Oren takes two damage from bad air.

scenes.title: The midnight bell
scenes.place: Shore below the drowned chapel, Gullwick bay
scenes.summary: A fisherman warns of the Kelp Mother, which the GM identifies as fishermen's lore. At midnight the submerged bell rings twelve times, louder humming returns, and pale figures appear in rows on the chapel floor before vanishing; the GM notes the choir clock is at three of six.

scenes.title: Tomorrow's dive
scenes.summary: The party plans a daylight, low-tide chapel dive tomorrow with Sela rowing them out; Vessa plans to buy rope and another lantern. Bram says Maren has a good heart and lost a brother to the bay; the party takes a long rest and returns to full health.
